blocks.html: Teleport to Karamja (shortest teleport is CKR) and run far south/southeast to the southeast corner of Shilo Village.
blocks.text: Teleport to Karamja (shortest teleport is CKR) and run far south/southeast to the southeast corner of Shilo Village.

blocks.html: Speak to Mosol Rei near the Broken cart. He will give you a wampum belt.
blocks.text: Speak to Mosol Rei near the Broken cart. He will give you a wampum belt.

options.text: Why do I need to run?
Rashiliyia? Who is she?
What can we do?
I'll go see the Shaman.
[Accept Quest]

blocks.html: Teleport to the Karamja lodestone and run southeast to Trufitus, northeast of Tai Bwo Wannai Village, west of the hardwood grove.
blocks.text: Teleport to the Karamja lodestone and run southeast to Trufitus, northeast of Tai Bwo Wannai Village, west of the hardwood grove.

blocks.html: Use the belt on Trufitus. Tell him you're going to search for "Ah Za Rhoon".
blocks.text: Use the belt on Trufitus. Tell him you're going to search for "Ah Za Rhoon".

options.text: Mosol Rei said something about a legend?
Why was it called Ah Za Rhoon?
I am going to search for Ah Za Rhoon!
Yes, I will seriously look for Ah Za Rhoon and I'd appreciate your help.

substeps.html: If you don't yet have a chisel, a rope and torch, you should get those now from Jiminua's Jungle Store. You may also craft bronze wire at the nearby anvil.
substeps.text: If you don't yet have a chisel, a rope and torch, you should get those now from Jiminua's Jungle Store. You may also craft bronze wire at the nearby anvil.

needed.html: Torch and rope

blocks.html: Travel east of Trufitus' hut, cross a wooden log and then head south to the mound of earth surrounded by three dead trees, Ah Za Rhoon.
blocks.text: Travel east of Trufitus' hut, cross a wooden log and then head south to the mound of earth surrounded by three dead trees, Ah Za Rhoon.

blocks.html: Search the mound of earth and select excavate.
blocks.text: Search the mound of earth and select excavate.

options.text: Try to excavate the mound.

blocks.html: Use a lit torch on the fissure.
blocks.text: Use a lit torch on the fissure.

substeps.html: To obtain a lit torch, light the torch in the backpack.
substeps.text: To obtain a lit torch, light the torch in the backpack.

blocks.html: Use a rope on the fissure.
blocks.text: Use a rope on the fissure.

blocks.html: Search the fissure, climb down.
blocks.text: Search the fissure, climb down.

options.text: Yes, I'll give it a go!

blocks.html: Search the cave in (see map) and wiggle through the rocks to proceed to the second area.
blocks.text: Search the cave in (see map) and wiggle through the rocks to proceed to the second area.

options.text: Yes, I'll wriggle through.

blocks.html: After wiggling through, follow along the west side of the wall and search the loose rocks against the northwestern wall for a tattered scroll.
blocks.text: After wiggling through, follow along the west side of the wall and search the loose rocks against the northwestern wall for a tattered scroll.

options.text: Yes, I'll carefully move the rocks to see what's behind them.

substeps.html: You might fail and take damage, retry until you succeed.
substeps.text: You might fail and take damage, retry until you succeed.

blocks.html: Search the old sacks in the far southeast corner for a crumpled scroll.
blocks.text: Search the old sacks in the far southeast corner for a crumpled scroll.

blocks.html: Search the ancient gallows to the north for the Zadimus corpse.
blocks.text: Search the ancient gallows to the north for the Zadimus corpse.

options.text: Yes, I may find something else on the corpse.

blocks.html: Read the scroll.
blocks.text: Read the scroll.

options.text: Yes please.

blocks.html: Use the Karamja lodestone/Tai Bwo Wannai teleport to get back to Trufitus.
blocks.text: Use the Karamja lodestone/Tai Bwo Wannai teleport to get back to Trufitus.

blocks.html: Use the tattered scroll and crumpled scroll on Trufitus.
blocks.text: Use the tattered scroll and crumpled scroll on Trufitus.

blocks.html: Use the Zadimus corpse on Trufitus.
blocks.text: Use the Zadimus corpse on Trufitus.

blocks.html: Ask about the sacred ground.
blocks.text: Ask about the sacred ground.

options.text: Is there any sacred ground around here?

blocks.html: Walk west to the nearby Tribal Statue. Bury the corpse then talk to the Spirit of Zadimus for the bone shard.
blocks.text: Walk west to the nearby Tribal Statue. Bury the corpse then talk to the Spirit of Zadimus for the bone shard.

blocks.html: Use the bone shard on Trufitus.
blocks.text: Use the bone shard on Trufitus.

options.text: It appeared when I buried Zadimus' corpse.
He said something after he gave it to me.
The spirit said something about keys and kin?

blocks.html: Talk to Trufitus. Ensure Trufitus mentions the need to find the Tomb of Bervirius.
blocks.text: Talk to Trufitus. Ensure Trufitus mentions the need to find the Tomb of Bervirius.

options.text: I need help with Bervirius.

needed.html: Bronze wire (or a bronze bar to make the wire)
needed.text: Bronze wire (or a bronze bar to make the wire)

blocks.html: Head southwest to Cairn Isle by climbing the rocks and going across the bridge. Be careful, you can sometimes fall - use the Surge ability to bypass this.
blocks.text: Head southwest to Cairn Isle by climbing the rocks and going across the bridge. Be careful, you can sometimes fall - use the Surge ability to bypass this.

blocks.html: Search the well stacked rocks to the north to enter the Tomb of Bervirius. If you fail search again until you are able to enter.
blocks.text: Search the well stacked rocks to the north to enter the Tomb of Bervirius. If you fail search again until you are able to enter.

options.text: Yes please, I can think of nothing nicer!

blocks.html: Inside, run south and search the tomb dolmen to receive three items: sword pommel, locating crystal, and Bervirius notes.
blocks.text: Inside, run south and search the tomb dolmen to receive three items: sword pommel, locating crystal, and Bervirius notes.

substeps.html: If you do not have enough space the notes will drop on the ground.
substeps.text: If you do not have enough space the notes will drop on the ground.

blocks.html: Read all 3 options on the Bervirius notes.
blocks.text: Read all 3 options on the Bervirius notes.

blocks.html: Use the chisel on the sword pommel to create bone beads (the chisel on the tool belt will not work).
blocks.text: Use the chisel on the sword pommel to create bone beads (the chisel on the tool belt will not work).

blocks.html: Use the bone beads on the bronze wire to create beads of the dead.
blocks.text: Use the bone beads on the bronze wire to create beads of the dead.

substeps.html: You can make the bronze wire from a bronze bar at an anvil near Trufitus.
substeps.text: You can make the bronze wire from a bronze bar at an anvil near Trufitus.

needed.html: 3 regular bones (can be obtained from monsters in cave)
needed.text: 3 regular bones (can be obtained from monsters in cave)

recommended.html: Three forms are weak to fire spells
recommended.text: Three forms are weak to fire spells

blocks.html: Travel east of Trufitus' hut, over the agility log and run north, to the general area of The Shaikahan. (Fairy ring: DKP)
blocks.text: Travel east of Trufitus' hut, over the agility log and run north, to the general area of The Shaikahan. (Fairy ring: DKP)

blocks.html: Search the foliage, then attempt to open the Ancient Door. (See the map for the location.)
blocks.text: Search the foliage, then attempt to open the Ancient Door. (See the map for the location.)

blocks.html: Use a chisel on the bone shard.
blocks.text: Use a chisel on the bone shard.

blocks.html: Equip the beads of the dead.
blocks.text: Equip the beads of the dead.

blocks.html: Use the bone key on the door to open it.
blocks.text: Use the bone key on the door to open it.

blocks.html: Open the ancient metal gate.
blocks.text: Open the ancient metal gate.

blocks.html: Climb down the rock.
blocks.text: Climb down the rock.

blocks.html: Run to the south west corner and use 3 bones on the tomb doors. Be careful not to bury them instead.
blocks.text: Run to the south west corner and use 3 bones on the tomb doors. Be careful not to bury them instead.

blocks.html: Open the doors and search the tomb dolmen.
blocks.text: Open the doors and search the tomb dolmen.

blocks.html: Kill all 3 forms of Nazastarool. The stalagmites to the east of the tomb dolmen can be used as a safe spot.
blocks.text: Kill all 3 forms of Nazastarool. The stalagmites to the east of the tomb dolmen can be used as a safe spot.

blocks.html: Search the tomb dolmen again for a Rashiliyia corpse.
blocks.text: Search the tomb dolmen again for a Rashiliyia corpse.

blocks.html: Travel back to the Tomb of Bervirius on Cairn Isle.
blocks.text: Travel back to the Tomb of Bervirius on Cairn Isle.

blocks.html: Use the Rashiliyia corpse on the tomb dolmen.
blocks.text: Use the Rashiliyia corpse on the tomb dolmen.

blocks.html: Quest complete!
blocks.text: Quest complete!

items.html: After completing the quest, you can sell every item you obtained during the quest to Yanni Salika in Shilo Village for 2,000 coins — 100 coins each for the stone-plaque, tattered scroll, crumpled scroll, Bervirius notes and the bone key, 500 coins for the locating crystal, and 1,000 coins for the beads of the dead.
